decisions.reason: The existing message-158 MODIFY already captures the Big Block change to 3 winners and a draw every 35,000 sales.
The existing message-158 MODIFY already updates the About-page block-prize copy for both Small and Big Blocks.
Changing winner counts and draw frequencies does not change the Chainlink VRF provider, fairness properties, verification surface, or applicable draws.
The source changes prize quantities and draw triggers, but tickets can still expire, burn, and reset according to the existing per-draw lifecycle.
The source does not change the mint price, commission, founder share, or prize-pool destinations; it explicitly says the net amount awarded remains the same.
Message 158 does not remove or modify Aave yield generation. Any redundancy assertion appears only in the later message 159 and cannot be propagated from this source Event.
The existing message-158 MODIFY already preserves the approved FAQ while updating both block-prize figures.
The source changes prize structure and cadence but does not resolve or alter whether prizes use manual claims, one-click redemption, or automatic payout.
The no-referral commission amount, trigger, and recipient-selection rule remain unchanged.
The source does not change coded-referral commission amount, eligibility, recipient, destination, timing, or cap.
Both Small and Big Block ticket counters remain valid metadata fields; changing draw cadence and winner count does not entail changing their visibility.
The source changes prize draw parameters but does not change the recipient or the 4 Small and 3 Big tickets issued per coded-referral mint.
